passages.heading: MD&A
passages.text: The following commentary should be read in conjunction with the consolidated financial statements and accompanying notes presented in this report. Within the tables presented throughout this discussion, certain columns may not add due to the use of rounded numbers for disclosure purposes. Percentages and earnings per share amounts presented are calculated from the underlying amounts. References to years throughout this discussion relate to our fiscal years, which end on September 30. Company Overview Description of the Company and Business Segments Becton, Dickinson and Company (“BD”) is a global medical technology company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of a broad range of medical supplies, devices, laboratory equipment and diagnostic products used by healthcare institutions, physicians, life science researchers, clinical laboratories, the pharmaceutical industry and the general public. The Company's organizational structure is based upon three principal business segments, BD Medical (“Medical”), BD Life Sciences (“Life Sciences”) and BD Interventional (“Interventional”). BD’s products are manufactured and sold worldwide. Our products are marketed in the United States and internationally through independent distribution channels and directly to end-users by BD and independent sales representatives. We organize our operations outside the United States as follows: EMEA (which includes Europe, the Middle East and Africa); Greater Asia (which includes countries in Greater China, Japan, South Asia, Southeast Asia, Korea, Australia and New Zealand); Latin America (which includes Mexico, Central America, the Caribbean and South America); and Canada. We continue to pursue growth opportunities in emerging markets, which include the following geographic regions: Eastern Europe, the Middle East and Africa (collectively referred to below as “EMA”), as well as, Latin America and certain countries within Greater Asia. As further discussed in Note 8 to the consolidated financial statements contained in Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data, effective October 1, 2025, we reorganized our organizational units into five distinct, separately-managed segments, based on the nature of our product and service offerings. BD’s new organizational structure is based upon the following five segments: Medical Essentials, Connected Care, BioPharma Systems, Interventional and Life Sciences, which remains a critical part of BD until the separation and combination of our Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (“Waters”) is completed. Additional disclosures regarding the agreement to combine our Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters are provided in Note 1 to the consolidated financial statements contained in Item 8. Financial Statements and Supplementary Data. Strategic Objectives BD remains focused on delivering durable growth, creating shareholder value and making appropriate investments for the future. credit_strengths.text: BD's revenue and operating income have grown steadily over the past three fiscal years, with operating margin holding near the low double digits. The diversified medical technology portfolio across Medical, Life Sciences and Interventional segments provides recurring demand from hospitals and laboratories, supporting cash generation through economic cycles.

Interest coverage remains adequate at above four times, with operating income comfortably exceeding gross interest expense. This headroom, combined with a current ratio above one, indicates the company can meet near-term obligations from operating earnings despite a leveraged balance sheet.

key_risks.text: Gross and net leverage stand near the mid-three times area, materially above the health care sector median. The indicative financial risk profile is Significant, and a modest EBITDA decline or incremental debt would push leverage through the four times threshold, limiting rating headroom.

The debt maturity profile concentrates near-term repayments, with a substantial portion of borrowings due within the next twelve months and the following two years. Refinancing this stack in a higher-rate environment could raise interest costs, while the company simultaneously funds shareholder distributions and a major portfolio separation.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: Operating income covers gross interest expense more than four times, but the absence of operating cash flow and free cash flow data prevents a full assessment of cash-based debt service. Capital expenditure is modest relative to revenue, yet cash flow coverage of debt cannot be verified from the available bundle.

Cash on hand is small relative to total debt, leaving the company reliant on refinancing and internal generation. Dividends and buybacks absorb significant cash, and with free cash flow unavailable, the sustainability of these distributions alongside debt reduction is uncertain.

overall_credit_view.text: BD is a large, diversified medical technology issuer with steady revenue and operating income growth, but leverage sits above the sector median and the indicative financial risk profile is Significant. The upcoming separation of the Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business adds execution and structural complexity.

Our forward view is cautious: leverage headroom is thin, near-term maturities are sizable, and shareholder returns consume cash. A successful separation and sustained earnings growth could support deleveraging, but absent operating cash flow disclosure, we treat the credit trajectory as stable-to-negative pending clearer cash flow visibility.

credit_strengths.text: BD 的營業收入及經營溢利於過去三個財政年度穩步增長，經營利潤率維持於低雙位數水平。橫跨醫療、生命科學及介入治療分部的多元化醫療科技組合，為醫院及實驗室提供經常性需求，支持現金產生能力穿越經濟週期。
利息覆蓋率維持於四倍以上之充足水平，經營溢利從容超過總利息支出。此緩衝空間，加上流動比率高於一，顯示儘管資產負債表具槓桿，公司仍能以經營盈利應付短期債務。

key_risks.text: 總槓桿及淨槓桿處於中三位數倍數區域附近，顯著高於醫療保健行業中位數。指示性財務風險狀況為「顯著」，而 EBITDA 溫和下降或債務增加，將推使槓桿突破四倍門檻，限制評級緩衝空間。
債務到期結構集中於短期還款，相當部分借款於未來十二個月及隨後兩年內到期。在利率較高環境下為此債務組合再融資，可能推高利息成本，而公司同時須為股東分派及重大業務組合分拆提供資金。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 經營溢利覆蓋總利息支出超過四倍，但缺乏經營現金流及自由現金流數據，無法全面評估以現金為基礎的債務償付能力。資本開支相對營業收入而言適度，惟現金流對債務的覆蓋情況無法從現有資料組合中核實。
手頭現金相對總債務而言規模較小，令公司依賴再融資及內部產生現金。股息及回購吸收大量現金，而由於自由現金流數據不可得，該等分派與債務削減並行的可持續性存在不確定性。

overall_credit_view.text: BD 為大型多元化醫療科技發行人，營業收入及經營溢利穩定增長，但槓桿高於行業中位數，且指示性財務風險狀況為「顯著」。即將分拆的生物科學及診斷解決方案業務，增添執行及結構複雜性。
我們的前瞻觀點趨向審慎：槓桿緩衝空間薄弱，短期到期債務規模可觀，股東回報消耗現金。分拆成功及盈利持續增長可支持去槓桿，但在缺乏經營現金流披露的情況下，我們將信貸軌跡視為穩定至負面，待現金流可見度更清晰後再作評估。
